description: Numeric cache of y_λ(q_0) at 50 dps for n ∈ {2, ..., 30}. Source for n=2..12 is `y-lambda-wenzl-bridge-symbolic-witness.json` evaluated via sympy.subs; source for n ≥ 13 is the numerical closed-form Wenzl-bridge evaluator (`y-lambda-wenzl-witness.json`, merged by `extend_y_lambda_at_q0_from_wenzl.py`). Output strings trimmed to exactly 50 dps via mp.nstr.
